topic: Writable startup validates effective timeout, operation, safety-margin, renewal-period, and
canonical_claim: Writable startup validates effective timeout, operation, safety-margin, renewal-period, and lease-TTL relationships before making the mount writable; invalid settings do not silently fall back to generic S3 defaults.

topic: Store::openForDecommission must impersonate the victim server_root_id, bump writer_epoch, start
canonical_claim: `Store::openForDecommission` must impersonate the victim `server_root_id`, bump `writer_epoch`, start a lease keeper, throw `ABORTED` when the member is alive, and throw `BAD_ARGUMENTS` when neither an owner anchor nor a mount body exists.

topic: Cas::decommissionPoolMember returns a DecommissionReport containing namespace,...
canonical_claim: `Cas::decommissionPoolMember` returns a `DecommissionReport` containing namespace, committed-ref, precommit, edge-delta, manifest-debris, staging, mountpoint, slot-removal, and warning fields; non-empty `warnings` means the slot is retained.

topic: Decommission emits the CasEventType::MemberDecommission event under the string name
canonical_claim: Decommission emits the `CasEventType::MemberDecommission` event under the string name `member_decommission` for begin, per-namespace, and end events.

topic: Decommission's staging and roots sweeps use paged LIST plus
canonical_claim: Decommission's staging and roots sweeps use paged LIST plus exact-token deletion; any per-object exception, `TokenMismatch`, or `NotFound` is recorded as a warning and the slot is kept as the resume anchor.

topic: The SQL surface is SYSTEM CONTENT ADDRESSED DROP POOL
canonical_claim: The SQL surface is `SYSTEM CONTENT ADDRESSED DROP POOL MEMBER '<srid>' FROM DISK '<disk>'`; the AST carries the srid in `query.replica` and the disk in `query.disk`, and the interpreter returns a one-row report result. The SQL decommission command leaves the executing server's own mount untouched by creating a separate admin claim of the victim srid over the same backend, executes synchronously, and returns the report as a one-row result set.

topic: Observer-side death decisions in rev.6, including GcFence and ClearExpiredMount
canonical_claim: Observer-side death decisions in rev.6, including `GcFence` and `ClearExpiredMount`, must use `mount.deadline + Drift <= clock`; the holder-side `Write` check remains `clock < fenceUntil`, and the deliberate `WallClockReclaim` sabotage is retained only to detect unsafe wall-clock trust.

topic: claimMount never reclaims a same-uuid, different-epoch lease solely because
canonical_claim: `claimMount` never reclaims a same-uuid, different-epoch lease solely because its wall-clock deadline passed; it returns `LiveDoubleStart` unless the lease is `gc_fenced`, carries the clean marker `min_active == UINT64_MAX`, or the caller supplies a matching proven-dead token.

topic: A clean store shutdown sets shutting_down, waits for ref
canonical_claim: A clean store shutdown sets `shutting_down`, waits for ref queues and leaders to settle within the request budget, and writes the farewell marker only when no unresolved conditional PUT wedge remains; otherwise it stops the lease keeper without a terminal farewell.

topic: A self-remount pays materialization_grace_ms only when refLanesSettledForRemount finds an
canonical_claim: A self-remount pays `materialization_grace_ms` only when `refLanesSettledForRemount` finds an unresolved wedge; a settled remount skips the grace and does not mark `unclean_epoch_boundary_seen`.; A self-remount waits for unresolved ref-log conditional PUTs to resolve and owes `materialization_grace_ms` only when at least one ref-log PUT remains unresolved.

topic: The writer's lease-liveness checks use local zero-request CLOCK_BOOTTIME fences
canonical_claim: The writer's lease-liveness checks use local zero-request `CLOCK_BOOTTIME` fences through `mayMutate` and `refAppendFenceOk`.

topic: A gc_fenced lease is a transferable certificate of observed
canonical_claim: A `gc_fenced` lease is a transferable certificate of observed death, so a successor may skip token observation and pay only `materialization_grace_ms`.

topic: A clean lease release drains all ref-append lanes and
canonical_claim: A clean lease release drains all ref-append lanes and writes `released_clean` only after every in-flight conditional PUT resolves within the ordinary request budget.; If clean-release draining leaves an unresolved PUT at the shutdown deadline, the `released_clean` marker is skipped and the successor treats the handover as unclean.; A `released_clean` marker skips observation, `T_mat`, and the recovery seal on ordinary restarts.

topic: Unclean takeover observes a stable lease token for mount_lease_ttl_ms
canonical_claim: Unclean takeover observes a stable lease token for `mount_lease_ttl_ms * 1.05 + poll_interval_ms` on the observer's monotonic clock before reclaiming with token-guarded `putOverwrite`.

topic: A durable reader pin at gc/readers/<reader_id> contains per-namespace base_snapshot
canonical_claim: A durable reader pin at `gc/readers/<reader_id>` contains per-namespace `base_snapshot` and `tail_head` values plus `lease_expiry`.

topic: Reader pins are pool-global, heartbeated, republished at reader start
canonical_claim: Reader pins are pool-global, heartbeated, republished at reader start, and ignored by GC after the reader lease expires.

topic: decodePoolMeta rejects a pool with min_reader_generation above G_BUILD or
canonical_claim: `decodePoolMeta` rejects a pool with `min_reader_generation` above `G_BUILD` or a generation below `kRefSnapshotLogGeneration` with `UNKNOWN_FORMAT_VERSION`.

topic: The proposed fetch-pin reaper used the existing min_active build-watermark
canonical_claim: The proposed fetch-pin reaper used the existing `min_active` build-watermark floor from `gc/server-roots/<srid>/mount`, not a wall-clock TTL.

topic: The mount-lease protocol is fail-closed: another writer cannot claim
canonical_claim: The mount-lease protocol is fail-closed: another writer cannot claim a slot until the current lease expires, so continuing to write while `now < lease_deadline` is safe unless a proven supersession has occurred.

topic: The implementation plan adds SingleWriterSlot::shouldFenceOnTransientRenewFailure() as a...
canonical_claim: The implementation plan adds `SingleWriterSlot::shouldFenceOnTransientRenewFailure()` as a protected virtual hook defaulting to `true`, with `MountLeaseKeeper` overriding it for deadline-aware retry behavior.

topic: MountLeaseKeeper refreshes its confirmed lease deadline on both successful
canonical_claim: `MountLeaseKeeper` refreshes its confirmed lease deadline on both successful `claim` paths and every successful background renewal.

topic: The new MountLeaseKeeper lease_safety_margin_ constructor parameter is appended after
canonical_claim: The new `MountLeaseKeeper` `lease_safety_margin_` constructor parameter is appended after the existing `event_sink_` parameter and has a default of 2000 milliseconds, preserving existing call sites.

topic: Production CasMountRuntime::installKeeper passes cas_request_budget.lease_safety_margin_ms...
canonical_claim: Production `CasMountRuntime::installKeeper` passes `cas_request_budget.lease_safety_margin_ms` to `MountLeaseKeeper`.

topic: The source-layout rename verification required the counts of build_seq
canonical_claim: The source-layout rename verification required the counts of `build_seq`, `buildSeq`, `BuildPrefix`, `allocateBuildSeq`, `active_build_seqs`, `next_build_seq`, and `inflight_builds` to remain unchanged across the `Build`→`PartWriteTxn` rename.

topic: Mount leases and epoch counters already use exact-token deletion
canonical_claim: Mount leases and epoch counters already use exact-token deletion plus rechecks, but `OwnerObject` contains only `server_uuid`, so an owner anchor written by a successor reclaiming the same `srid` is indistinguishable from stale debris from the decommissioned server.

topic: The decommission tombstone preserves the same server_uuid, sets retired_at_ms
canonical_claim: The decommission tombstone preserves the same `server_uuid`, sets `retired_at_ms` to the current time, and writes it with the prior owner token through `Backend::putOverwrite(owner_key, encodeOwner(...), owner->token)`.

topic: The recovery retry loop releases rt.state_mutex before sleeping and
canonical_claim: The recovery retry loop releases `rt.state_mutex` before sleeping and re-acquires it afterward; this avoids stalling the whole-store `wedgedRefLaneCount` walk, and the default sleep is interruptible when `fence_ok_fn()` becomes false.

topic: A proposed shared checkNotReadOnly helper is intended to guard
canonical_claim: A proposed shared `checkNotReadOnly` helper is intended to guard all four mutating CAS entry points: transactions, GC round, GC rebuild, and pool-member decommission.

topic: Clean termination after the mount lease object has vanished
canonical_claim: Clean termination after the mount lease object has vanished is a no-op release and must not throw `LOGICAL_ERROR`; a present foreign incarnation remains a genuine logic error.

topic: ContentAddressedMetadataStorage::startup should build the pool, facade, capability result, and
canonical_claim: `ContentAddressedMetadataStorage::startup` should build the pool, facade, capability result, and scheduler in locals and publish `cas_store`, `part_access`, `pool_uuid`, `conditional_copy_supported`, and `gc_scheduler` in one final pointer-mutex section; a startup exception must publish nothing.
